# Public-market regression fixtures

Two fixed OGNUSDT public Binance market snapshots and original seven-field model text support deterministic offline replay; no credentials, request headers, production ledger or Outbox. These are development fixtures, not blind financial-quality evidence. Existing private audit originals stay local and unchanged. The old sealed record is read-only; missing-clock tests delete metadata only in a cloned fixture. Fixture original market values, timestamps and model text are preserved.
